WITH cleaned_weather AS (
    -- Remove duplicates by keeping the first record for each location_id + date
    -- Also filter out NULL temperatures and unreasonable values
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (dw.location_id, dw.date)
        dw.location_id,
        dw.date,
        dw.max_temp_c,
        dw.min_temp_c,
        dw.avg_temp_c
    FROM daily_weather dw
    WHERE dw.max_temp_c IS NOT NULL
      AND dw.min_temp_c IS NOT NULL
      AND dw.avg_temp_c IS NOT NULL
      -- Filter out unreasonable temperature values
      AND dw.max_temp_c BETWEEN -100 AND 60
      AND dw.min_temp_c BETWEEN -100 AND 60
      AND dw.avg_temp_c BETWEEN -100 AND 60
    ORDER BY dw.location_id, dw.date, dw.max_temp_c DESC
)
SELECT 
    l.name AS location_name,
    l.country,
    TO_CHAR(cw.date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    ROUND(AVG(cw.avg_temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS monthly_avg_temp_c,
    ROUND(MIN(cw.min_temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS absolute_min_temp_c,
    ROUND(MAX(cw.max_temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS absolute_max_temp_c,
    COUNT(*) AS days_with_valid_data
FROM cleaned_weather cw
INNER JOIN locations l ON cw.location_id = l.location_id
GROUP BY l.location_id, l.name, l.country, TO_CHAR(cw.date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY l.name, month;
